reports_message_evidence.name: reports_message_evidence
reports_message_evidence.value: "reports"."target_type" <> 'message' OR ("reports"."evidence_sender_id" IS NOT NULL AND "reports"."evidence_sent_at" IS NOT NULL)

reports_resolution_complete.name: reports_resolution_complete
reports_resolution_complete.value: "reports"."status" = 'open' OR ("reports"."resolution" IS NOT NULL AND "reports"."resolved_by" IS NOT NULL AND "reports"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL)
